decisions.reason: As a simple accessory closely linked to the firm's trailer business it is easy for the firm to understand and improve, but its lower strategic prominence makes discontinuation somewhat more plausible if demand is modest.

A box car trailer series builds directly on the firm's established trailer design, production and service capabilities, and its home-page visibility suggests management sees it as an important core offering.

A car transporter trailer remains strongly related to the firm's existing know-how in road transport equipment, though as a more specialized niche product it carries a somewhat higher risk than mainstream trailer lines.

A low-bed trailer series fits the firm's accumulated engineering and manufacturing knowledge very well, and its prominent marketing indicates confidence in commercial applicability and further learning.

A high trailer cover series is a natural extension of the firm's existing trailer and accessory base, so the firm is well placed to absorb customer feedback and refine it rather than withdraw it quickly.

This box car trailer series also sits squarely within the firm's core competence set, although overlap with other trailer lines creates a slightly higher chance of rationalization than for a single flagship series.
